c74object.name: evi_polyblep_two
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_polyblep_two.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_polyblep_two.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
Two-point PolyBLEP bandlimited oscillators, classic waveform shapes. This file also includes novel morphing oscillator types. When calling any of these functions you must deal with gain and dc yourself.

entry.name: poly_blep ( )
entry.description:
Two-point PolyBLEP bandlimited step function for antialiasing oscillators

In 2: type=input: dt, Phase increment
